A '''head transplant''' was a procedure to remove or take a removed head from a sentient being and transfer it onto another body to keep them alive. [[Iaco Stark/Legends|Iaco Stark]] was decapitated in an industrial accident on [[Reltooine]] and presumed to be dead, but in reality; survived and had his head grafted onto a droid body, partly due to developing a distaste for organics.<ref name="Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 4">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 4|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 4]]</ref>
